mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every m>=1, the full displayed integer matrix has rank 2m+2, primitive kernel generated by (1,0,-1,-1_i,0_i), while the source-identity subsystem has rank 2m+1 with the additional spectrum-shift generator (0,0,1,0_i,1_i).
mechanisms.kill_test: Find one rank, kernel or maximal-minor failure for m<=24; otherwise require a symbolic unit-minor and substitution proof.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The observable quotient of the full formal matrix has nontrivial torsion growing with m even after fixing gauge.
mechanisms.kill_test: A maximal minor of determinant plus or minus one kills every nontrivial Smith torsion claim.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The m identities b-r_i-q_i=0 contribute m independent ranks beyond the source and complement observable rows.
mechanisms.kill_test: Substitute the observable equations and test whether every identity reduces to b+g+f=0.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Adding each new row index removes one further gauge direction, so the full formal kernel is zero for sufficiently large m.
would_close: automatic unit rigidity from many rows
mechanisms.kill_test: Apply the common gauge vector for arbitrary m and check every new row.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Before complement spectra are fixed, the source-identity subsystem already has rank 2m+2 and only the gauge kernel.
mechanisms.kill_test: Apply the common spectrum-shift vector and compute the exact source-only rank.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every actual power-large paired-positive common-X block has exactly the variables and rows of the formal all-m matrix, with all absolute complement observables fixed on a power-large fibre at subpower cost.
would_close: actual-block realization of formal primitive gauge lemma
mechanisms.kill_test: Audit the exact-block extraction theorem for a complete variable/row list and a charged common absolute-spectrum fibre; kill any inference based only on the finite three-row witness.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Primitivity of the scalar incidence matrix implies the full actual Laurent-unit quotient is torsion-free and rank zero after gauge, independent of the ambient coefficient ring and exponent lattice.
mechanisms.kill_test: Introduce an unfixed coefficient unit or an extra exponent-lattice coordinate and test whether scalar primitivity controls it.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Positive rank of the pre-spectrum observable quotient forces a uniform increase in the number of distinct target-target distance labels.
would_close: distance gain from observable unit motion
mechanisms.kill_test: Use the fixed-X shifts 0 and 1/4, whose absolute label sets differ, and compare their exact distinct-label counts.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The formal primitive full-matrix theorem itself makes conditioning on every absolute complement spectrum entropy-free because the source-identity data already determine those spectra.
mechanisms.kill_test: Apply the spectrum-shift kernel of the source-identity subsystem; arbitrary shifts with identical source-identity data refute determination by the formal theorem.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The actual-block primitive gauge theorem, together with controlled observable spectra, propagates to all qU targets retaining t^(28/9-o(1)) pair occurrences and fibre below t^(1/9-epsilon), hence improves the dimension-three exponent beyond 3/5.
mechanisms.kill_test: Require explicit occurrence, fibre and outer-stability inequalities on the same all-target domain; selected-row capacity or a conditional matrix lemma fails.
